# Papermind

> Papermind is an AI-powered study platform that turns PDFs, notes, and textbooks into personalized quizzes, flashcards, study guides, and mock exams.

Papermind helps students and professionals learn faster from their own study materials. Users upload a document, then use AI-generated learning tools and performance tracking to focus on weak topics and prepare for exams.

## Product

- [Papermind](https://www.usepapermind.app/): AI study tool for transforming study materials into interactive learning resources.
- [Pricing](https://www.usepapermind.app/pricing): Plans, included features, and subscription options.
- [About Papermind](https://www.usepapermind.app/about): Papermind's mission to make learning more effective and personalized.

## How it works

1. Upload PDFs, notes, or study guides.
2. Generate quizzes, flashcards, study guides, and mock exams from the material.
3. Review performance and revisit topics that need more practice.

## Use cases

- [NCLEX-RN preparation](https://www.usepapermind.app/use-cases/nclex-rn): Use Papermind to prepare for the NCLEX-RN exam.
